breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。

aliases_zh: 非特异性溃疡性结肠炎
curated.category: 消化系统与自身免疫性肠病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 主要累及直肠和结肠黏膜及黏膜下层的弥漫性溃疡性炎症，呈慢性复发缓解过程，持续全结肠炎8-10年后结直肠癌变率攀升；但在突发“急性重度溃疡性结肠炎（ASUC）”时，数日至数周内可并发中毒性巨结肠、结肠穿孔、下消化道大出血及腹腔感染性休克而危及生命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 轻中度患者一线使用美沙拉嗪（口服+栓剂/灌肠）即可获良好维持控制；中重度患者通过生物制剂（维得利珠、抗TNF-α、抗IL-23单抗）及口服小分子药（乌帕替尼等JAKi及S1P调节剂）可达成内镜黏膜愈合；内科难治或暴发型中毒性巨结肠患者通过全结肠切除+回肠储袋肛管吻合术（IPAA）亦可实现临床外科根治。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021将UC与克罗恩病合并统计为IBD：2021年全球IBD合计年死亡约42,000例，未单列UC单独死亡数字；现代规范生物治疗与适时结肠切除已使急性重度UC住院病死率降至1%-3%以下

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: GBD 2021估算2021年中国全IBD合计年死亡约5,640例，未单拆UC；暴发型中毒性巨结肠延迟手术或并发巨细胞病毒感染、静脉血栓栓塞为主要死亡诱因

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球范围内溃疡性结肠炎患病率普遍高于克罗恩病（欧美发达国家可达200-500/10万人），全球发病率仍随工业化饮食与环境转型不断上升。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国IBD患者中溃疡性结肠炎人数仍多于克罗恩病（中国城区的粗IBD年发病率达10.04/10万人年，整体呈现快速城市化相关升高趋势，30-40岁青壮年多发）。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 急性重度溃疡性结肠炎（ASUC，Truelove-Witts标准：血便≥6次/日+发热/心动过速/贫血/高血沉）住院抢救：1) 立即排除艰难梭菌及巨细胞病毒（CMV）感染后静脉给予甲泼尼龙40-60 mg/日（警惕大剂量掩盖穿孔）；2) 第3天若Travis标准未达标（便次>8次或3-8次伴CRP>45 mg/L）果断启动英夫利西单抗或环孢素静脉挽救，并同步肝素预防静脉血栓（VTE）；3) 出现中毒性巨结肠（横结肠直径>6 cm）、腹膜炎或大出血立即联合外科行次全结肠切除+末端回肠造口挽救生命。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 2025-2026年默沙东抗TL1A单抗Tulisokibart在3期ATLAS-UC诱导期研究中成功达到全部主要与次要终点，标志针对肿瘤坏死因子样配体1A全新机制治疗中重度UC取得3期突破；2) 口服S1P受体调节剂Etrasimod、Ozanimod与抗IL-23p19家族（Mirikizumab、Guselkumab、Risankizumab）丰富了无激素长程黏膜愈合管线；3) 工程化粪菌移植与活体生物药研究深入开展。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 中重度UC即使使用最强效JAK或生物制剂仍有约40%-60%患者未能实现持久临床缓解或出现继发失应答；2) 糖皮质激素不合理长期反复滥用导致骨质疏松与机会性感染依然普遍；3) 直肠急迫感及全结肠切除IPAA术后慢性储袋炎（Pouchitis）尚缺理想疗法。

master.definition_en: Juvenile hyaline fibromatosis (JHF) is a rare soft tissue tumor, characterized by papulo-nodular skin lesions (especially around the head and neck), soft tissue masses, gingival hypertrophy, joint contractures, and osteolytic bone lesions in variable degrees. Joint contractures may cripple patients and delay normal motor development if occurring in infancy. Severe gingival hyperplasia can interfere with eating and delay dentition. Histopathology analysis of involved tissues reveals cords of spindle-shaped cells embedded in an amorphous, hyaline material. JHF is a mild form of infantile systemic hyalinosis.

master.definition_en: Abnormalities in the development of the cerebral cortex. These include malformations arising from abnormal neuronal and glial cell proliferation or apoptosis (Group I); abnormal neuronal migration (Group ii); and abnormal establishment of cortical organization (Group iii). Many inborn metabolic brain disorders affecting cns formation are often associated with cortical malformations. They are common causes of epilepsy and developmental delay.

master.definition_en: A rare ophthalmic disorder characterized by a non-infectious uveitis potentially involving all parts of the uveal tract and due to a paraneoplastic autoimmune reaction. The signs and symptoms usually precede the tumor diagnosis and may include ocular redness and pain, light sensitivity, blurred vision, floaters, and decreased vision. The most classic form is the intermediate uveitis associated with anti-CV2 antibodies in small-cell lung cancer or other neoplasms. Other ocular and/or extra-ocular manifestations are commonly present in addition.

master.definition_en: Onychocytic matricoma is a rare tumor of the nail that is generally benign. Affected people often experience thickening of the involved portion of the nail. The tumor may be pigmented (melanonychia - a black or brown pigmentation of the normal nail plate) or non-pigmented. The exact underlying cause of onychocytic matricoma is currently unknown. It generally occurs sporadically in people with no family history of the condition. Treatment generally consists of surgical excision.

master.definition_en: Focal epilepsy-intellectual disability-cerebro-cerebellar malformation is a rare, genetic neurological disorder characterized by early infantile-onset of seizures, borderline to moderate intellectual disability, cerebellar features including dysarthria and ataxia and cerebellar atrophy and cortical thickening observed on MRI imaging. Seizures are typically focal (with prominent eye blinking, facial and limb jerking), precipitated by fever and often commence with an oral sensory aura (anesthetized tongue sensation). When not properly controlled by anti-epileptic medication, weekly frequency and persistence into adult life is observed.

curated.category: 遗传代谢与溶酶体贮积罕见病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: GBA1基因双等位基因突变致溶酶体酸性β-葡糖脑苷脂酶缺乏，大量葡糖脑苷脂蓄积于单核-巨噬细胞形成“戈谢细胞”，导致巨脾、重度贫血/血小板减少出血、骨痛骨坏死；II型急性神经病变型多在2岁前因延髓喉痉挛及脑干衰竭死亡，I型和III型呈慢性进展。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 针对I型及III型内脏血液受累的酶替代疗法(ERT)可显著缩小肝脾并恢复血象；中国于2025年5月批准首个本土自主研发ERT“维拉苷酶β(戈芮宁)”有望打破进口百万天价垄断，但ERT均不能穿透血脑屏障治疗II/III型中枢受累。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与GBD未单列戈谢病全球年死亡数；II型急性神经病变型未治患儿常于<2岁死亡，I型经足量ERT治疗预期寿命明显改善

master.definition_en: A rare mitochondrial disease characterized by a distinctive MRI pattern of cavitating leukodystrophy, predominantly in the posterior region of the cerebral hemispheres. The clinical picture varies widely between acute neurometabolic decompensation in infancy with loss of developmental milestones, seizures, and pyramidal signs rapidly evolving into spastic tetraparesis, to subtle neurological symptoms presenting in adolescence. The disease course tends to stabilize over time in most patients, and marked recovery of milestones may be observed.

master.definition_en: A rare, chronic cutaneous lupus erythematosus disease characterized by red or violaceous, initially pruritic (evolving to painful) papules and plaques located on acral areas (especially dorsal aspects of fingers and toes, while the nose and ear involvement is uncommon), exacerbated by cold and damp conditions, with fissuring and ulceration occasionally observed. Coexistence of discoid lupus erythematosus lesions elsewhere on the body and occasional progression to systemic lupus erythematosus may be associated. Histological examination and direct immunofluorescence studies reveal nonspecific inflammatory lupus erythematosus changes while results of cryoglobulin and cold agglutinin studies are negative.

master.definition_en: Acalvaria is a rare malformation defined as missing scalp and flat bones over an area of the cranial vault. The size of the affected area is variable. In rare cases, acalvaria involves the whole of the dome-like superior portion of the cranium comprising the frontal, parietal, and occipital bones. Dura mater and associated muscles are absent in the affected area but the central nervous system is usually unaffected, although some neuropathological abnormality is often present (e.g. holoprosencephaly or gyration anomalies). Skull base and facial bones are normal.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A disorder characterized by episodes of swelling under the skin (angioedema) and an elevated number of the white blood cells known as eosinophils (eosinophilia). During these episodes, symptoms of hives (urticaria), fever, swelling, weight gain and eosinophilia may occur. Symptoms usually appear every 3-4 weeks and resolve on their own within several days. Other cells may be elevated during the episodes, such as neutrophils and lymphocytes. Although the syndrome is often considered a subtype of the idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndromes, it does not typically have organ involvement or lead to other health concerns.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: A rare myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by clinical, laboratory, and morphological features of both myelodysplastic syndrome and myeloproliferative neoplasm at onset, in the absence of recent cytotoxic or growth factor therapy, and without Philadelphia chromosome, BCR-ABL1 or PCM1-JAK2 fusion, or rearrangement of PDGFRA, PDGFRB, or FGFR1. Cases of a previously well-defined myeloproliferative neoplasm developing dysplastic features are excluded, and the criteria for any other myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm, myelodysplastic syndrome, or myeloproliferative neoplasm are not met.
